column1: Set a fine-mesh strainer lined with paper towels over a bowl, add the ricotta, and let it drain 5–10 minutes.
Blanch the spinach in a large pot of boiling salted water for 30 seconds, then drain, squeeze dry and chop finely.
Mix the spinach, ricotta, egg, Parmesan and nutmeg in a medium bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Use right away or refrigerate up to 1 day.
Place 1/2–1 1/2 tsp of filling in small mounds on the pasta dough. Don't overfill or the ravioli won't stay sealed.
Brush the edges with a little water, cover with dough, press out any air and seal. Cut into ravioli.
Boil the ravioli a few minutes until they float.
Serve with butter sage sauce or a simple tomato and garlic sauce.
